title: Best Bookshelf (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Products were chosen from the listed sources, favoring items mentioned by more than one source and covering both physical bookshelves and bookshelf‑style speakers.
assumptions: No price comparisons were made because most sources omitted pricing; any price shown comes directly from the source.

verdict.line: Buy this if you want a Wi‑Fi speaker that blends into home décor and works with Sonos multi‑room. It offers bright sound, app‑based EQ and Trueplay, but you must buy separate wall‑mount brackets.
